Short title and commencement

ACT XLVIII OF 1975
ACT XLVIII OF 1975
DANGEROUS DRUGS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act further to
amend the Dangerous Drugs Act, 1930
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 29th April 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 25th April 1975, and is hereby
published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Dangerous Drugs (Amendment)
Act, 1975.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 2, Act II of 1930

ACT XLVIII OF 1975
ACT XLVIII OF 1975
DANGEROUS DRUGS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act further to
amend the Dangerous Drugs Act, 1930
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 29th April 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 25th April 1975, and is hereby
published for general information:
2. Amendment of section 2, Act
II of 1930.-In the Dangerous Drugs Act, 1930 (II of 1930), hereinafter
referred to as the said Act, in section 2, in clause (g), for sub-clause (i)
the following shall be substituted, namely:-
"(i) all coca derivatives,
medicinal hemp, opium derivatives, charas in any form and any mixture of stalks
and flowering or fruiting tops of the Indian hemp plant (cannabis sativa L.),
and".

Amendment of section 23, Act II of 1930

ACT XLVIII OF 1975
ACT XLVIII OF 1975
DANGEROUS DRUGS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act further to
amend the Dangerous Drugs Act, 1930
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 29th April 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 25th April 1975, and is hereby
published for general information:
3. Amendment of section 23,
Act II of 1930.-In the said Act, in section 23, in subsection (1),-
(a) after the words and comma
"Provincial Government,", the words and comma "or an officer of
the Pakistan Narcotics Control Board authorised by the Chairman of the Board in
this behalf," shall be inserted; and
(b) the following Explanation
shall be added at the end, namely:-
"Explanation.-In this
section and sections 29 and 30, `Pakistan Narcotics Control Boards' means the
Pakistan Narcotics Control Board re-constituted under the Government of
Pakistan, Planning Division, Resolution dated the 8th March 1973.".

II of 1930.----In the said Act, in section 29, in subsection (1), after the
figure "30" at the end, the words and commas "or, in the case of
a person arrested or article seized by an officer of the Pakistan Narcotics
